parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-generated key (e.g. a UUID v4) that makes a retried request safe (ADR-0027). Clients MUST always send a non-empty value on the routes that declare it: a deployment backed by Postgres (every real deployment) rejects a request without it with 400 idempotency-key-required. It is declared optional here only because the in-memory development mode (which the contract test boots) does not enforce it. Reuse the SAME key for retries of one logical request (same body) — the first response, success or business error, is stored and replayed byte-for-byte for the key's TTL (24h by default) — and a NEW key for each new logical request. Reusing a key with a different body is rejected with 422 idempotency-key-reused.
